title: UNICEDE/1 vs UNICEDE/2
text:
UNICEDE
/1 vs 
UNICEDE
/2

Legacy information associated with 
UNICEDE
/2.

A summary of the differences between the two 
UNICEDE
 data formats is presented below.

Note:
 
UNICEDE
/1 files are not supported in 
Touchstone Re
.

| Category | UNICEDE /1 | UNICEDE /2 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Countries | U.S. only | All countries currently modeled by Verisk . |
| Perils | Single peril - not specified in file | Multiple perils can be specified in file. |
| Data Types | Sums-Insured only | Sums insured, premiums, number of risks, payroll (Workers'
 Compensation). |
| Lines of Business | Supports four aggregated CATRADER lines of business:
 Homeowner, Mobile Home, Commercial, Auto | Supports country-specific lines of business. |
